subjectTemplate: Your partner left your entry for {eventTitle}
bodyTemplate:
Hi {memberName},

{entrantName} is no longer entered with you in {divisionName} at {eventTitle} ({eventDates}). You are still registered, now looking for a partner in {divisionName}.

You can choose a new partner from the event's page on footbag.org until registration closes. After that, the organizers can pair you at the event.

International Footbag Players Association
